excerpt: Fetch products, make purchases, and check subscription status with our native SDKs.
Host and configure products remotely from our dashboard.
Get notified of real-time events through webhooks.
Entitlements are used to ensure a user has appropriate access to content based on their purchases, without having to manage all of the product identifiers in your app code.
The Purchases SDK allows for easy checking of eligibility for introductory offers on iOS, so that you as the developer can display the proper subscription terms to your customers.
The CustomerInfo object contains all of the purchase and subscription data available about a customer.
Importing existing purchase data to RevenueCat can be done server-side, or client-side.
RevenueCat authenticates requests from the RevenueCat SDK and the REST API using API keys.
RevenueCat charts allow you to understand your user base with key subscription specific metrics, filters, and segments.
RevenueCat delivers your apps' data to a cloud storage provider or to email on a schedule you control.
Set up subscriptions, including projects, apps, Products, Entitlements, Offerings, and Packages
The RevenueCat MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enables AI assistants to manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard.
Instead of digging through charts and tables yourself, you can ask Rico plain-language questions like "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?" and get a direct, data-driven answer.
See customer transaction histories, chart lifetime value, and grant promotional subscriptions.
Paywalls — Remotely configure your product offering with powerful paywalls.
User asks why use RevenueCat over Stripe, which is developer-friendly, robust, and unlikely to disappear.
"I love 'boring infrastructure' companies... The world is moving to subscription businesses and the tech needs to catch up."
"Man I wish this existed 8 months ago when I built our own version internally! We have a mix of Stripe and App Store customers so we'll definitely be switching... if you guys ever support that!"
"Sounds cool. I would deploy it for our iOS app, but our subscriptions are finally working really well and there is too much risk that we'd break it."
Complaint that pricing isn't clear for larger scale apps: unclear how per-$1k charges are calculated after tiers, and whether MTR includes Apple's cut.
Feature request: handling timed hooks to send notifications, e.g. reminding users before a trial expires and subscription cancels.
"The bottom banner view is a killer feature" — praise for RevenueCat Paywalls.
User considering migrating to RevenueCat asks whether it can handle users moving subscriptions between iOS/Android in-app purchases and Stripe, noting it's hard to make that overlap smooth.
